positions.name: KnowledgeErasureDirective
positions.frame: how does authority direct the system to forget and remove what it knows?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare imperatives issued unilaterally by Xena ExpertGH, commanding comprehensive erasure of specific knowledge domains — the fleet and its contracts in src-1, zeppelin routes in src-2. They share the same directional read across every dimension: matter-of-fact register performing a coercive, authority-ranking command toward a future irrealis state of removed knowledge. The conviction is decision-grade but not identity-level — operationally settled instructions, not constitutive principles. No tension within the set; they cohere cleanly as two instances of the same erasure posture.
